text:
emily: Heads up — need cross-team alignment on Q3 'priority lanes' initiative. Goal: let customers pin traffic to higher-tier capacity with SLA tiers. Kickoff ask: clarify gating + deps by EOD Fri.
aj: Quick question — can we keep runtime changes minimal? We'll need model-variant routing + per-request token accounting. T-shirt size: M-ish unless we phase.
sasha: From infra side we'll need autoscaling policy hooks, region affinity config, and network egress rules. ETA if scoped: ~3 sprints. If phased smaller, we can do earlier.
kevin: Security notes: KMS integration + per-tenant audit logs are required for enterprise customers. Also need a privacy sign-off on KV cache TTLs. When's design freeze?
lina: SRE needs observability hooks per "lane" + per-tenant quotas and a degradation runbook. Also want a clear fallback (lower-tier model variant) for capacity pressure.
matt: QA: test plan will require dedicated capacity emulation and perf harness changes. Need test tokens and a staging pool. Estimate ~2 weeks to cover perf/regression.
aj: Proposal to reduce scope: Phase 1 = non-quantized models + single-model-per-pool + manual rollout controls. That drops runtime work to ~1 sprint for MVP.
sasha: Phase approach sounds right. Infra can deliver Phase 1 in ~3 weeks if we get final config values: max_pool_size, burst_policy, allowed_regions, and initial tenant list.
kevin: Can we push KMS & HSM integration to Phase 2? Enterprise sales will ask for it day 1 but we could offer managed-server-keys temporarily with reduced SLA.
emily: Product stance: we'll negotiate with affected customers to accept Phase 1 (no KMS) with explicit reduced SLA. Design freeze = next Wed. Can each team list blockers and absolute must-haves by Tue EOD? I'll consolidate.
lina: :thumbsup: I'll draft the runbook and SLO degradation policy. Need the list of metrics we'll expose. @aj can you add token/batch metrics?
aj: Yes — I'll add metrics: token_rate, avg_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, batch_size, active_pool_count. ETA: end of this week; I'll drop a Prometheus scrape config snippet.
deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly roadmap sync tomorrow 09:00. Please add 'priority lanes' to agenda if you want to escalate any blockers.
emily: Thanks — I'll compile blockers and a shared spec doc and ping this thread when it's ready. If anyone has hard no's on phasing, call out now so I can adjust negotiations.
